harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate native-object-recheck on a real bundle and discharge only static object symbol, call-edge and linked-placement correspondence. This route never discharges any machine_code_* check, including machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv, bounded-loop TV and callee-saved preservation; object_translation_correspondence also remains unperformed. No register, ABI/runtime, CRT/loader, OS exit-status, universal object-TV or Evidence-reuse claim is made. A wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm (the bounded native profile atom main() -> i64 requires: true).
Step 1 runs `native-bundle build`, verifies the record pins exit status 0 plus the SHA-256 of empty stdout and stderr, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the trusted-channel build ID.

Step 2 runs native-object-recheck and asserts the matching object symbol, call-edge and linked-placement checks, object_correspondence_schema, and that no machine_code_* check is discharged. The checks_not_performed list includes machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv, machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation, machine_code_bounded_loop_function_tv and object_translation_correspondence.

Step 3 reruns with a wrong build ID and asserts no claimed outcome, full current checks_not_performed including every machine_code_* check and machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv, no selected result, and normalized exit_code 1.

name: Declared Native Object Recheck (native-object-recheck)
description: A bounded native-object-recheck for static object symbols, call edges and linked placements. It never discharges any machine_code_* check, including entry-wrapper TV, callee-saved preservation and bounded-loop TV; object_translation_correspondence also remains unperformed. It makes no register, ABI/runtime, CRT/loader, OS exit-status, universal object-TV or Evidence-reuse claim.

intro: Build a return-0 native object bundle.
Recheck only symbols, call edges and links.
narrative.before: The static object correspondence fields have not yet been rechecked.
narrative.after: Only object symbol, call-edge and link correspondence ran. No machine-code/register, ABI/runtime, CRT/loader, OS exit-status, universal object-TV, or Evidence-reuse claim is made.
narrative.moment: Static object fields only; machine TV, entry wrapper, runtime and Evidence reuse remain unclaimed.

result_message: Result: bounded object fields only; no machine-TV claim.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show native-object-recheck executing a real bundle's bounded symbol-surface, direct-call-edge and linked-placement correspondence checks. It never discharges any machine_code_* check, including entry-wrapper, callee-saved and bounded-loop TV; object_translation_correspondence remains unperformed. No register, ABI/runtime, CRT/loader, OS exit-status, universal object-TV or Evidence-reuse claim is made, and a wrong build ID yields no outcome.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1 with object_recheck == 'corresponds', discharged_checks == ['artifact_semantics', 'claim_truth', 'object_call_edge_correspondence', 'object_link_correspondence', 'object_symbol_correspondence'], checks_not_performed includes every current machine_code_* check, including machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv, machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation and machine_code_bounded_loop_function_tv, plus object_translation_correspondence.

wrong_report.json carries no object_recheck, object_correspondence_schema or discharged_checks, the full current checks_not_performed list including every machine_code_* check and object_translation_correspondence, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

steps.name: Produce a native bundle with pinned outputs
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==0, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); link_build pins exit status 0 and the empty stdout/stderr digests; bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the complete record contains all three runtime observation pins.

steps.name: native-object-recheck reports bounded correspondence
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-object-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['object_recheck']=='corresponds', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['artifact_semantics','claim_truth','object_call_edge_correspondence','object_link_correspondence','object_symbol_correspondence'], r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['file_identity','freshness','machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv','machine_code_bounded_loop_function_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_preservation_assumed_for_external_callees','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation','machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv','machine_code_direct_call_site_tv','machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv','machine_code_leaf_function_tv','object_translation_correspondence','producer_authenticity','semantic_correspondence'], r; assert not any(check.startswith('machine_code_') for check in r['discharged_checks']), r; assert r['object_correspondence_schema']=='mumei.object-symbol-correspondence/v1', r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; print('native-object-recheck: only static symbol, call-edge and link correspondence; no machine_code_* check discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1 with matching bounded object-symbol, direct-call-edge and linked-placement checks; no machine_code_* check, including machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv, is discharged.
steps.verifier_gate: native-object-recheck exits 0; artifact reproduction and static object correspondence pass while every machine-code TV check remains unperformed.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-object-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_object_recheck/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); expected=['artifact_semantics','claim_truth','file_identity','freshness','machine_code_acyclic_branch_function_tv','machine_code_bounded_loop_function_tv','machine_code_callee_saved_preservation_assumed_for_external_callees','machine_code_callee_saved_register_preservation','machine_code_conditional_call_function_tv','machine_code_direct_call_site_tv','machine_code_entry_wrapper_tv','machine_code_forward_branch_function_tv','machine_code_leaf_function_tv','object_call_edge_correspondence','object_link_correspondence','object_symbol_correspondence','object_translation_correspondence','producer_authenticity','semantic_correspondence']; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-object-recheck-report/v1'; assert 'object_recheck' not in r and 'object_correspondence_schema' not in r and 'discharged_checks' not in r; assert r['expected_build_id']==hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest(), r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==expected, r; assert not any(check.startswith('machine_code_') for check in r.get('discharged_checks',[])), r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') == 1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: no machine_code_* discharge; no claimed outcome, exit 1')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json holds no object_recheck, object_correspondence_schema or discharged_checks; full current checks_not_performed includes every machine_code_* check and object_translation_correspondence, with no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1.
steps.verifier_gate: The mismatched build ID exits nonzero inside Core and yields no claimed outcome.
